item.title: WCO National Workshop on Data Analytics for Cuba Customs
item.description:
The WCO BACUDA Project, conducted a National Workshop on Data Analytics for the General Customs of the Republic of Cuba (AGR) in Havana from 2 to 6 November 2026. I took part as Co-facilitator and a member of the WCO Secretariat facilitation team.

The workshop covered:

  • Artificial intelligence (AI) concepts
  • Data quality and governance
  • Risk management
  • Generative AI and computer vision applications in Customs
  • Institutional readiness assessment using the WCO AI/ML Readiness Self-Assessment Tool

The programme strengthened the capacity of AGR officials in data analytics, AI and evidence-based decision-making. Working in groups, participants identified the AGR’s existing strengths and areas for improvement, laying the groundwork for a future AI/ML implementation roadmap.

Through the BACUDA Project, the WCO continues to support Customs administrations in building the knowledge and capabilities needed to harness data and emerging technologies for smarter, more effective Customs operations.

More information on the WCO BACUDA Project website: National Workshop on Data Analytics for Cuba Customs
